name: Shurik i vse, vse? Vse!
source:
What is a person? A person is the sum of all the efforts, feelings, and emotions of all those who are close to them. 

And who is close to Semyon, to a loner who chose self-flagellation? Only someone who has experienced something similar. But will he be able to help Semyon?
translation:
什么是人？一个人是所有与他亲近的人的所有努力、感受和情感的总和。

谁与谢苗、一个选择自虐的孤独者亲近？只有经历过类似事情的人。但他能帮助谢苗吗？
